conclusions.run: Local SDK starts a new scan unless undocumented CLI-internal options are supplied.
conclusions.publicAPI: CodexSecurity and ScanOptions have no public resume() / resumeScanId entry point.
conclusions.cli: Upstream CLI supports eligible running Deep scans; the exact-version Web adapter uses the same internal SDK continuation path without a user CLI.
conclusions.applicationRecovery: Exact-version Deep continuation bridge, fenced to original running scan/session/source/checkpoints; legacy result restore and reexecution stay separate.
